title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.36759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). translated_title: DocSkill：面向多语言多跳文档问答的技能集成式智能体推理
translated_abstract: 多语言多跳文档问答（MMHop-DocQA）需要在复杂版面、文档页面以及多种语言之间定位并整合证据。现有方法包括单次处理和自适应工具使用，但学习协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证仍然充满挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了DocSkill，一个具备可学习的技能编排策略的智能体框架，用于实现自适应的证据获取与推理。该策略根据不断演化的证据状态来选择、重访或跳过相应技能。为构建技能编排的监督信号，我们利用有界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在离线阶段探索备选的技能轨迹。这些轨迹为监督微调（SFT）提供了示范样本，并为直接偏好优化（DPO）提供了偏好对。此外，我们还引入了MMHop-DocBench，一个多语言多跳文档问答基准。
tldr: DocSkill提出了一个具有可学习技能编排策略的智能体框架，通过离线MCTS探索技能轨迹生成SFT示范与DPO偏好对来训练模型，实现自适应的证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证，并发布了多语言多跳文档问答基准MMHop-DocBench。
en_tdlr: DocSkill introduces an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy—trained via offline MCTS trajectories providing SFT demonstrations and DPO preference pairs—to enable adaptive evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification for multilingual multi-hop document QA, along with the new MMHop-DocBench benchmark.
